compiled_state.title: As a bridge operator, I want a synthetic drift-injection test that verifies one scheduled pass heals injected drift, so that self-healing is provably end-to-end.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
End-to-end self-healing proof. Test harness injects {orphaned Jira issue, mis-mapped label, missing property}, waits one scheduled pass, verifies anomaly resolved and bridge-fsck returns zero.

## Done Definitions
- Drift-injection harness has 3 modes (orphan, mis-mapped label, missing property) and runs each end-to-end against the live workflow ← Satisfies: sc-6
- Each injection produces an anomaly visible in bridge-fsck before the next scheduled pass ← Satisfies: sc-6
- After one scheduled pass, bridge-fsck returns zero for the injected anomaly class with no operator intervention ← Satisfies: sc-6

## Considerations
- [Test Hygiene] Injection harness must operate on a designated test issue or sandbox project.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
